thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need a decision for Private deploy OKRs: prioritize VPC control-plane parity (can manage customer control plane in VPC) vs full air-gapped packaging (offline installers + install docs). Acme + HealthCo both pushing hard.
kevin: Do we have a clear SLO/ROI comparison? ie cost to build vs revenue/ops savings per customer? :thinking_face:
sanjay: Short answer: control plane gives faster time-to-value for most of the pipeline features (rollouts, metrics). Airgap is high effort (packaging + support) and has larger ongoing ops cost.
elaine: From compliance side, HealthCo will only accept air-gapped or fully on-prem (no external control plane). Acme would accept VPC private control plane. So it's a customer-segmentation trade.
maria: Agreed. I'm leaning canary VPC control-plane support first (Q3), then airgap packaging as Q4 epic for regulated verticals. But need to validate engineering capacity and security review.
julian: FYI — Acme has a POC deadline end of Q3. If we delay VPC control-plane, we'll lose momentum.
kevin: Can we define minimum viable scope for airgap that buys time? e.g., offline tarball + doc + one-day on-site handoff — not full automated installer.
sanjay: That reduced scope still has tricky points: KMS/HSM integration, ephemeral PKI, upgrade path. Ops support will be heavier.
elaine: Also flag: audit logging must be kept on-device, plus ability to export logs for audits. That adds code surface.
maria: Action: kevin to draft a two-option spec (VPC-first vs airgap-minimal) with dev effort estimate and risk matrix by EOD Wed. Assign owners for security review.
kevin: I'll do that. Will include: perf impact (latency), auth flow differences, infra cost delta.
julian: Can we get a quick customer-impact matrix? I'll pull customer asks and revenue priority to help triage.
sanjay: I'll scope KMS/HSM and upgrade migration impact — rough hours.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Q3 roadmap planning doc updated — please add your spec link under "private-deploy".
maria: Good catch. We'll link kevin's spec once ready. Also: propose OKR wording: "Ship VPC private control plane MVP for key enterprise customers" (KR: support 3 customers + <100ms median control-plane ops).
kevin: One extra tradeoff: VPC control plane requires cross-region network design for high-availability. That could push infra cost up 15-25%.
elaine: Compliance note: document the minimal evidence set we need to give auditors for the VPC model vs airgap. I'll draft that checklist.
maria: If we do VPC-first, we must guarantee a fallback to a local-only mode for customers that later require airgap — otherwise rework is huge. Add to risk column.
julian: I'll notify the customer success lead. We should get a prioritization call with Sales + PM on Friday.
kevin: Will include migration story in spec (how to move from VPC-control-plane to airgap later).
sanjay: Timeline wise: VPC-MVP (Q3 sprint 1-3), airgap-minimal (Q4 sprint 1-4) — still needs headcount validation.
maria: Ok — thanks all. If no objections, we'll present VPC-first + airgap follow-up at Friday roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
